ValidationRule.description: Validate Paraguay RUC accepts only number and letters
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Administrador do sistema', $Profile.Name <> 'API Only profile', NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, "Master Data")), ISPICKVAL( BillingCountryCode , "PY"), !REGEX( PMC_SS_RUC__c ,"^\\d{1,35}?$") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only numbers are accepted for RUC
